reviewMethod: Projected pinned source polygons to EPSG:2154, measured the single connected remainder against only the INAO-listed commune, and inspected the complete overview and enlarged component.
finding: The 279.136890 m² remainder (1.775885%) is one connected strip along the northern and western INAO edges, tapering at the eastern corner. Its large enclosing rectangle reflects the bent edge, not a missing interior parcel. Visually inspected the overview and enlarged component. Only Chassagne counts as imported coverage; other bundle communes remain neighbours. The 279.2 m² source-hash-bound cap allows less than 0.064 m² above the measured difference.
